objects.name: Analytic 1893
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol session reading back the user program from a field device to a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, where the session byte count is consistent with a substantial portion of the device's program memory. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
